# Result-only nominal factory formal

Owned Java 8 fixture for a private static factory whose nominally bounded
method formal appears only in its invariant result carrier. A closed context
supplies no type binding. Frozen external reflection, method handles and direct
callers observe original provider effects, null failures, raw holder casts,
returned identity, later getter casts and checked/Error identity. Source and
SDK-provider profiles compare every original definition and declaration and
compile every generated Java unit. No original classfile or DEX is patched.
